CustomJoint.kinematic_program: source-derived canonical FunctionBased binary sidecars have bounded Metal pose, H, Hdot, H-transpose wrench projection, and Hdot times qdot primitives; the pinned CPU FP64 reference admits immutable FunctionBasedJointProgram records into analytic Jacobian mass/bias evaluation and state advance
CustomJoint.cpu_reference_payload: The provenance-locked 22-body Rajagopal rigid tree can load source mass, inertia, COM, joint-frame, coordinate, and FunctionBased-program records into the FP64 reference probe.
CustomJoint.requirement: Register source frames to BodyParts3D geometry and collision proxies, then extend Metal ABA and MetalWorld state stepping. The bounded Metal articulated operator admits FunctionBased joints for source-tree poses, point Jacobians, mass assembly, and impulse response; it is not an ABA or MetalWorld admission.

UniversalJoint.requirement: Represent a source-faithful coupled two-axis joint in the articulated solver.

fully_locked_zero_default_lowering.condition: All source coordinates are locked and have exactly zero default value, so the source joint transform is its fixed zero-coordinate transform.

source_faithful_requirements: source-frame muscle force and moment-arm scatter
